Name: Panorama Windows
Author: Lavliette
Description:
This mod allows you to retexture the logpanels and the 'jade hills extended'-painting into panorama windows by using Alternative Textures.

I'd love to see more Panorama variation from other talented modders, so I'm giving full permission to upload your own versions.
Just link back to this mod or my profile in your description, that's all!

Downloads.Description: Retextures the Log Panel and 'Jade Hills Extended' via AT
